novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new phenomenon/setting: “a model's ABSTENTION POLICY ... transmits subliminally” through “trait-free number/code data,” specifically predicting an accuracy-dissociated shift in when a student withholds answers. Searches for “subliminal learning abstention policy,” “refusal threshold transfer hidden signals number data,” and “selective prediction synthetic-data distillation” found Cloud et al., “Subliminal Learning: Language models transmit behavioral traits via hidden signals in data,” as the closest work; refusal-direction papers such as SCANS and COSMIC address steering rather than covert cross-model transmission. Moving from Cloud et al.'s transmission of preferences and misalignment to abstention is a natural but non-trivial transfer to a meta-level decision policy, while the proposed “prominent causal early-layer abstention-disposition direction” largely combines established early-layer subliminal-learning localization with standard refusal-direction analysis rather than adding a new measurement paradigm. Thus, no essentially equivalent abstention-transmission work was identified, but the core direction remains predictable from the prior claim that subliminal learning is general across behavioral traits.
